[p]Our public playtest is once again open! It will close 00.00 CEST July 7th![/p][p]To play: visit our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126410/Expedition_Into_Darkness/"]steam store page[/url] and sign up for access!

Looking for friends to play with? Join our [url="https://discord.gg/QKfTnWhm2G"]Community Discord[/url]![/p]

notes.title: Team expansion, revised release date, and a new playtest!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]First, the exciting stuff: the team at Antediluvian has grown! Join us in welcoming another six members into our covenant. Personal introductions are soon to follow.[/p][p]
We are also preparing to move into our new Stockholm office, of which you will see more on our social channels! This is a huge step forward for us and marks a new chapter for our once tiny indie startup—one that will let us build faster, better, and with more ambition.[/p][p][/p][p]As a result of the team expansion and our upcoming office move, we haven’t been able to add new content to the playtest build. But we will be opening up a fresh two-week playtest with our previous build starting June 23rd, lasting until July 7th, so you can play while we settle into our new workspace.[/p][p][/p][p]Given our expanded team, we’ve made the decision to postpone the launch from our original September 2025 window to late Q1 or early Q2 of 2026. We believe this extra time will let us fully deliver on the potential you’ve seen in the playtests and create something truly special.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for your patience and support. The community continues to be an incredible motivator for us, and we can’t wait to show you what’s coming next.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll see you in the darkness.
[i]Antediluvian Interactive[/i][/p]

notes.title: End of the Open Alpha Playtest
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for everyone who participated in the open alpha playtest! Your feedback and bug reporting has been invaluable to us!

We will keep the signups open, as we plan to open more playtests in the near future with more content.
Make sure you follow us on your preferred social media or join our [url=https://discord.gg/QKfTnWhm2G]community discord[/url] to get updates on new playtests as soon as possible!

All the best,
[i]Antediluvian Interactive[/i]

notes.title: Gameplay Reveal & Open Alpha Now Available!
notes.notes:
The time has come! We are beyond excited to unveil the first gameplay trailer for [i]Expedition: Into Darkness[/i]! This is the first real look at the brutal, co-op dungeon-crawling experience that awaits you.

But that's not all—we’re opening the gates for an [b]Open Alpha[/b]! From now until [b]April 12th, 12:00 CEST[/b], you can dive into the darkness and experience [i]Expedition: Into Darkness[/i] firsthand with all your friends!

[previewyoutube=PaucD1EOopo;full][/previewyoutube]

Looking for party members?

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/QKfTnWhm2G]Community Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Early Explorer Program announced!
notes.notes:
We are incredibly excited to announce our first playtesting program: the [b]Early Explorer Program[/b].
Designed to help us playtest and iron out bugs before we open up to more public playtests.

Do you have previous testing experience and would like to help us make Expedition: Into Darkness the best game it can be? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/QKfTnWhm2G]Community Discord[/url] and apply today!

We hope you have an amazing weekend!
[i]Antediluvian Interactive[/i]

notes.title: Season's Greetings
notes.notes:
As the year comes to a close, we’re taking a moment to celebrate and reflect on an incredible journey so far. 2024 has been an unforgettable year for us at [i]Antediluvian Interactive[/i], and we couldn’t have done it without you, thank you for being part of this journey.

We’re hard at work preparing an exciting gameplay reveal to kick off 2025, but for now, we’ll let you enjoy the holiday season.

Happy Holidays and Merry Christmas,

notes.title: OTK Winter Games Expo
notes.notes:
We’re excited to share that [i]Expedition: Into Darkness[/i] will be featured in the OTK Winter Games Expo! This digital event, hosted by the OTKnetwork, highlights some of the most exciting upcoming games, and we’re honored to be part of the lineup.

For those of you who have been following the journey of Expedition: Into Darkness, this is a major milestone. The OTK Winter Games Expo is the perfect chance to share a closer look at the game we’ve been pouring our hearts into. We can’t reveal too much just yet (we wouldn’t want to spoil the mystery, after all), but we are looking forward to connecting with you during the Expo and hearing your thoughts as we continue working toward release. The event runs online, so you can tune in from anywhere—no need to brave the darkness alone!

Thank you for your continued support, be sure to follow us here on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126410/Expedition_Into_Darkness/?utm_source=steamcommunity&utm_campaign=OTKAnnouncement]Steam[/url] or join the conversation on [url=https://discord.gg/QKfTnWhm2G]Discord[/url] to stay updated on everything happening at the OTK Winter Games Expo and beyond.

notes.title: Customization
notes.notes:
Our latest video dives into the extensive customization options currently available in [i]Expedition: Into Darkness[/i]. 

In this video, we have unlocked all currently available options—when you are playing, you will of course have to acquire these materials either via expeditions into the dungeons or via crafting and trading.

Our customization system allows you to change everything about your equipment and weapons to suit your style—all the way down to the lacing on your doublet or the specific heads and feathers on your arrows. 

Think we missed something, or got the perfect idea? Let us know in our [url=https://discord.gg/QKfTnWhm2G]community discord[/url]!

You can watch the video right down below, and if you haven't already—don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126410/Expedition_Into_Darkness/]wishlist us on the Store[/url]!

[previewyoutube=JLl6ZeMV_rA;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JLl6ZeMV_rA[/previewyoutube]
